Silicon Valley investment, global semiconductor engagement and expanding customer-driven engagement position Edgewater for its next phase of commercialization
October 20, 2026 – TheNewswire - Ottawa, Canada  – Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc.

(“Edgewater” or the “Company”), the industry pioneer of AI-powered Wi-Fi Spectrum Slicing™ silicon solutions and IP, today announced its participation in Canada’s Semiconductor Symposium 2026, taking place on October 20-21 in Ottawa, Ontario, as the Company advances its next-generation wireless silicon toward customer demonstrations and commercial adoption.

Edgewater enters the Symposium with growing momentum, supported by strategic investment, global industry engagement and customer-driven development across next-generation Wi-Fi and high-performance dual-use wireless applications.

Recent milestones include a strategic investment from Silicon Catalyst Angels—its first investment in a publicly traded company—and an invitation to GlobalFoundries' GFx Technology Summit, where Edgewater engaged with senior semiconductor executives, strategic investors and industry partners. The Company also participated in the RDK Global Summit, connecting with leading global broadband operators, OEMs and technology partners.
Together, these developments are strengthening Edgewater's industry visibility and access to the expertise, relationships and resources needed to accelerate commercialization.

“Industry and financial validation are providing the resources and access to advance our silicon toward customer demonstrations and commercial adoption,” said Andrew Skafel, President and CEO of Edgewater Wireless. “The Silicon Catalyst Angels investment, our growing engagement with global semiconductor leaders and increasing customer interest are coming together at an important point in our development. We're moving beyond proving the technology toward demonstrating what it can deliver for customers—and building the foundation for scalable commercial opportunities.”
Advancing Toward Customer Demonstrations and Design-Ins

Edgewater continues to advance PrismIQ™, its Wi-Fi 8-ready family of Spectrum Slicing™ semiconductor solutions, with development priorities increasingly shaped by prospective customer requirements and high-performance applications.

The Company's patented multi-channel architecture is designed to deliver greater throughput, reduced latency and more predictable wireless performance—capabilities increasingly important for next-generation broadband, enterprise connectivity and mission-critical wireless communications.

Beyond traditional Wi-Fi markets, Edgewater sees growing opportunities in dual-use applications, including autonomous systems, resilient wireless video links and low-latency command-and-control communications, where reliability and interference resilience are critical.

Customer-driven engineering activities are helping shape upcoming prototype capabilities and demonstration priorities, with the Company focused on progressing qualified opportunities toward potential design-ins and commercial adoption.

“What's particularly exciting is how our technology is opening doors beyond conventional Wi-Fi,” added Skafel. “We're seeing opportunities where reliable, high-performance wireless connectivity is a critical requirement, not simply a convenience. Our focus now is on converting these opportunities into tangible technical and commercial milestones, particularly in the emerging dual-use market.”
Global Industry Support Strengthens Execution
Edgewater's development program benefits from its relationships with Arm, Synopsys and Silicon Catalyst, alongside engagement with GlobalFoundries and Canada's semiconductor innovation ecosystem.

Through CMC Microsystems and the FABrIC initiative, Edgewater has secured approximately $921,000 in non-dilutive project support toward its next-generation wireless baseband development and commercialization program, helping extend development resources while limiting reliance on shareholder capital.

Hosted by CMC Microsystems under the theme “Where Sovereignty Meets Prosperity,” Canada's Semiconductor Symposium brings together technology leaders, policymakers, investors and innovators focused on strengthening Canada's semiconductor industry and global competitiveness.

Edgewater will use the event to advance industry relationships, engage prospective strategic partners and highlight its progress toward bringing Canadian-developed wireless semiconductor technology to global markets.
Attending Canada's Semiconductor Symposium? Connect with Edgewater at marketing@edgewaterwireless.com to arrange a meeting.
About Edgewater Wireless
We make Wi-Fi. Better.

Edgewater’s patented, AI-powered Spectrum Slicing™ platform—delivered through the PrismIQ™ product family—breaks the limits of legacy Wi-Fi by enabling multiple concurrent channels in a single band. Wi-Fi Spectrum Slicing™ delivers a 10x improvement in performance and up with 50% lower latency, even for legacy devices. With 26 patents granted and 3 AI-related patents pending, Edgewater’s is transforming the economics of Wi-Fi for service providers, OEMs, and enterprises—powering scalable, standards-leading connectivity across residential, enterprise, and Industrial IoT markets.  A Silicon Catalyst Portfolio Company with strategic investment from Silicon Catalyst Angels, Edgewater is an industry pioneer in its understanding of the future of Wi-Fi and is building the foundation for the next era of global connectivity which the company defines as intelligent wireless.
